author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
We're appointing some senior moderators to take on the role of map developer. To kick off, we have a new map developer in the team with us today! You know him as mainly Michael, but also Sulorak and Straightened.

Everyone give him warm congratulations (and maybe a warm cookie). The team is now 100% more funky.
